items.name: Army Camp
items.info: Your troops are stationed in Army Camps. Build more camps and upgrade them to muster a powerful army.

items.name: Town Hall
items.info: The heart of your village! Upgrade your Town Hall to unlock new defenses, buildings, traps, and much more.\n\nDestroying an opponent's Town Hall earns you one star in battle. Protect your Town Hall from attacks by placing it in the middle of your village and surrounding it with walls, traps, and defenses.

weapon.name: Inferno Artillery
weapon.info: Bring the heat! The Inferno Artillery launches 4 enemy-seeking explosives and leaves burning pools of fire where it strikes. If there are less than 4 enemies in range, it can strike the same target multiple times. Ouch!

items.name: Elixir Collector
items.info: Elixir is pumped from Ley Lines coursing underneath your village. Upgrade your Elixir Collectors to maximize Elixir production.

items.name: Elixir Storage
items.info: These storages contain the Elixir pumped from underground. Upgrade them to increase the maximum amount of Elixir you can store.

items.name: Gold Mine
items.info: The Gold Mine produces Gold. Upgrade it to boost its production and Gold Storage capacity.

items.name: Gold Storage
items.info: All your precious Gold is stored here. Don't let sneaky Goblins anywhere near! Upgrade the storage to increase its capacity and durability against attacks.

items.name: Barracks
items.info: The Barracks allow you to train troops to attack your enemies. Upgrade the Barracks to unlock advanced units that can win epic battles.

items.name: Laboratory
items.info: What dark secrets do these Wizards hide inside their Laboratory? Nobody has dared to look. All we know is that their research makes our spells and troops harder, better, faster, and stronger!

items.name: Cannon
items.info: Cannons are great for point defense. Upgrade Cannons to increase their firepower, but beware that your defenses cannot shoot while being upgraded!

items.name: Archer Tower
items.info: Archer Towers have longer range than Cannons, and unlike Cannons, they can attack flying enemies.

items.name: Wall
items.info: Walls are great for keeping your village safe and your enemies in the line of fire.

items.name: Wizard Tower
items.info: The Ultimate Arcane Defense! Tower Wizards cast powerful area effect spells that target both flying and ground troops.

items.name: Air Defense
items.info: This anti-air tower is deadly against flying enemies, but can't target foes on the ground. Place it wisely to cover as much airspace as possible.

items.name: Mortar
items.info: The Mortar can mow down hordes of attackers with splash damage. Just don't let enemies get too close!

items.name: Clan Castle
items.info: The Clan Castle houses your Treasury and any reinforcement troops or Spells sent by your clanmates.

items.name: Builder's Hut
items.info: Nothing gets done around here without Builders! You can hire more builders to start multiple construction projects, or speed up their work by using green gems.

items.name: Hidden Tesla
items.info: Lay a deadly trap with the Hidden Tesla! Our Wizards have trapped a storm cloud into each of these sneaky towers. When an enemy walks or flies close enough, the tower springs up and fries it using the power of Electrickery!

items.name: Spell Factory
items.info: The Spell Factory is home to veteran Wizards who are better suited to creating magical weapons than front-line combat. Use their powerful Attack Spells to turn the tide of battle in your favor!

items.name: X-Bow
items.info: The X-Bow shoots mystical bolts with terrifying power. Load it with Elixir and the X-Bow works automagically. You can set it to target ground units at long ranges, or all targets at reduced range.

items.name: Dark Elixir Drill
items.info: Our Builders have finally figured a way to extract pure Dark Elixir, the rarest form of the magical substance.

items.name: Dark Elixir Storage
items.info: The power of Dark Elixir could not be contained in a regularly shaped Elixir vat. As it's three times as powerful, we had to invent a cubical form of storage!

items.name: Dark Barracks
items.info: The Dark Barracks will open doors for creatures born out of Dark Elixir. Upgrade the Barracks to unlock more Troops with unique battle skills.

items.name: Inferno Tower
items.info: Set the Inferno Tower's flame to inflict immense damage on single targets, or to constantly melt multiple targets at once.

items.name: Air Sweeper
items.info: Air Sweepers control the sky with strong blasts of air that push back flying enemies. Air Sweepers can only face one direction, so rotate them to maximize their effectiveness.

items.name: Dark Spell Factory
items.info: Only the most brilliant or reckless Master Wizards dabble in Dark Elixir brewery. Their compact Dark Spells require keen insight to master, but provide unique tactical advantages.

items.name: Eagle Artillery
items.info: The Eagle Artillery has nearly unlimited range and targets tough enemies with exploding shells. However, it won't activate until a large amount of troops have been deployed.

items.name: Bomb Tower
items.info: Bomb Towers bombard nearby ground troops and go up in a big BOOM when destroyed! Melee units best stand clear!

items.name: Wall
items.info: Walls are great for keeping your village safe and your enemies in the line of fire.

items.name: Builder Hall
items.info:
Home of the Master Builder and the main objective in battle.

Destroying a Builder Hall awards a Star in attacks. Destroying 50% of buildings in a stage gains you a second Star, while 100% destruction awards three Stars for the stage.

Upgrade the Builder Hall to unlock advanced buildings and troops!

items.name: Elixir Collector
items.info: Elixir is pumped from Ley Lines coursing underneath your village. Upgrade your Elixir Collectors to maximize Elixir production.

items.name: Elixir Storage
items.info: These storages contain the Elixir pumped from underground. Upgrade them to increase the maximum amount of Elixir you can store.

items.name: Gold Mine
items.info: The Gold Mine produces Gold. Upgrade it to boost its production and Gold Storage capacity.

items.name: Gold Storage
items.info: All your precious Gold is stored here. Don't let sneaky Goblins anywhere near! Upgrade the storage to increase its capacity and durability against attacks.

items.name: Clock Tower
items.info: The Clock Tower makes things happen faster in your village! Collect resources, research and build faster.

items.name: Builder Barracks
items.info: The Builder Barracks trains troops for Builder Battles! You can also quickly swap troops immediately before attacking. Upgrade the Builder Barracks to unlock more troop types!

items.name: Double Cannon
items.info: Double Cannons, double shots per Cannon, It's a double-double dose of trouble!

items.name: Army Camp
items.info: Your troops are stationed in Army Camps. Each camp can house only one troop type at a time. Some troops can be upgraded to fit more units per camp!

items.name: Hidden Tesla
items.info: Part tower, part trap, completely shocking! Zap air and ground foes alike with the power of science!

items.name: Cannon
items.info: The iconic ground defense, built to last! This classic makes the Master Builder a bit sentimental.

items.name: Multi Mortar
items.info: Fires long range splash damage multiple times to maximize chances of hitting its target!

items.name: Star Laboratory
items.info: The Star Laboratory searches the heavens for secrets to unlock a troop's full potential. Improve troop hitpoints, damage and housing space in addition to special troop abilities!

items.name: B.O.T.O’s Shack
items.info: Master Builder saved this little guy from the scrap heap. Despite a few loose screws, B.O.T.O is eager to help with tasks around Builder Base!

items.name: Archer Tower
items.info: No foe can escape the Archer's arrows. This tower has a special switch - choose long range or fast attack!

items.name: Reinforcement Camp
items.info: Reinforcement Camps provide helpful reinforcements during battles when reaching the corresponding stage.

items.name: Firecrackers
items.info: Keep flying pests away with flurries of small rockets! It's like a bug zapper, but prettier.

items.name: Guard Post
items.info: Houses troops to aid in defense! These rabble rousers are sure to slow down the enemy.

items.name: Mega Tesla
items.info: What happens when a Tesla goes Mega? Its powerful jolt deals heavy damage to even the toughest units!

items.name: Battle Machine
items.info: This massive machine broke attempting to hoist the realm's biggest hammer. With some repairs, it could be taken into battle!

items.name: Air Bombs
items.info: For heavyweight air defense, Air Bombs do the trick. An endless supply of explosive barrels launch into the sky to ravage flying enemies!

items.name: Crusher
items.info: The Crusher REALLY likes its personal space. This hulking stone slams ground units with a mighty wallop!

items.name: Roaster
items.info: Bathe foes with a fiery flood of scalding plasma! Both air and ground troops will feel the burn!

items.name: Giant Cannon
items.info: Nothing gets in the way of the Giant Cannon. Its mammoth-sized cannon balls push past anything and just keep going and going and going...

items.name: Gem Mine
items.info: Gem Mines access a rare deposit of this highly valuable resource! Mining Gems is slow and hard work.

items.name: Workshop
items.info: The Workshop is where Siege Machines are built. Upgrade the Workshop to unlock different Siege Machines!

items.name: Lava Launcher
items.info: Hurls molten rock over great distances. Sets the ground on fire, which really turns up the heat for enemy ground troops!

items.name: B.O.B's Hut
items.info: B.O.B, a totally normal Builder, lives here among us. Definitely not a robot controlled from the Builder Base.

items.name: B.O.B Control
items.info: Control center for Master Builder's latest invention! Once fully upgraded, B.O.B becomes an additional builder in the Home Village!

items.name: Scattershot
items.info: The Scattershot heaves very heavy objects at whoever happens to be closest. The projectile breaks apart on impact and deals additional damage to troops behind.

items.name: Pet House
items.info: Every Hero deserves a loyal companion. The Pet House allows you to unlock powerful Pets with various abilities to fight alongside your Heroes.

items.name: Blacksmith
items.info: Bring the right magical Ores here and your Heroes' Equipment can be upgraded to be even mightier! The smoke from the furnace helps make delicious, if unhealthy, brisket.

items.name: Hero Hall
items.info: This fancy Hall honors your Village's mightiest warriors! Visit the Hero Hall for all your heroic essentials, and to upgrade Heroes. Upgrade the Hero Hall to unlock more Heroes!

items.name: Spell Tower
items.info: For years, Wizards alone brought magic to the battlefield one fireball at a time. Now they've developed a fully automated way to give your village more ways to mess up attackers with magic!

items.name: Monolith
items.info: Builder's first Dark Elixir experiment resulted in a truly frightful defense. The stronger the Monolith's target, the more damage it does. Great to have defending your village, but a little intimidating to take on.

items.name: O.T.T.O's Outpost
items.info: O.T.T.O´s home and the main building of the second stage. May contain additional feisty robots.\n\nDestroying O.T.T.O´s Outpost awards an extra star in attacks.

items.name: Multi-Gear Tower
items.info: The Multi-Gear Tower is a powerful combination of two classic defenses! Choose the attack mode that suits you and let the destruction begin! Targets air and ground units.

items.name: Battle Copter
items.info: Get to the Copter! Tired of hammering through walls, Master Builder's next-generation flying machine lets him soar over them. The Battle Copter attacks from afar with its powerful Cannons; or can get up close and personal when using its Bomb Rush ability.

items.name: X-Bow
items.info: The X-Bow shoots powerful bolts with terrifying power. You can set it to target ground units or air units.

items.name: Healing Hut
items.info: Brews up a hearty and nourishing cauldron of soup following Master Builder's grandma's recipe. Troops eat some on their way to the next stage of an attack, recovering some of their health.

items.name: Sour Elixir Cauldron
items.info: This haunted creation by the strangely behaving Builder transforms your regular Elixir Storages into Sour Elixir. Hopefully this is just temporary.

items.name: Multi-Archer Tower
items.info: These Archers have teamed up to take out attackers faster and more furiously than ever. Teamwork makes the dream work!

items.name: Ricochet Cannon
items.info: Builder has used one weird trick to develop a devastating cannonball that will ricochet and hit a second target.

items.name: Revenge Tower
items.info: If you destroy its building friends, the Revenge Tower will look for you, it will find you, and it will smite you. As fellow buildings fall, it grows stronger and angrier!

items.name: Firespitter
items.info: The Firespitter spews flames at a fire rate faster than the X-Bow! If it misses, the Firespitter will shoot past its target to deal damage to enemies behind. It can only face a single direction, so place carefully!

items.name: Helper Hut
items.info: Helpers rest up on a warm bunk bed in this cozy little hut! Visit the Helper Hut and assign Helpers to jobs around the village.

items.name: Crafting Station
items.info: Build Crafted Defenses and upgrade their stats however you like! Crafted Defenses last until a Crafting Phase ends. New defenses will take their place with the next phase! Experiment with new defenses and you might just find a new favorite!

seasonal_defenses.name: Hot Candle
seasonal_defenses.info: The flickering flame of the Hot Candle flings fire spurts at multiple surrounding enemies! Better make your wish quick, as this defense’s target capacity decreases as it melts.

seasonal_defenses.name: Hero Hunter
seasonal_defenses.info: Headhunter wants to play a game!\n\nThis destructive deck dealer targets all troops but serves extra damage to Heroes! Card projectiles cause slowdown and result in poisoned paper cuts.

seasonal_defenses.name: Cake-A-Pult
seasonal_defenses.info: One splash-damage serving at a time!\n\n Cake surrounding enemies in destructive and delectable... cake. When this dessert drops, it leaves an explosive surprise, ensuring no one is around for seconds.

items.name: Super Wizard Tower
items.info: Super Wizard’s first strike can shock up to fifteen nearby enemies. Chained targets take less damage.
